title: Securities Commission member steps down
content:
27 April 2010

Securities Commission member steps down

  • Simon Power
Commerce

Commerce Minister Simon Power has accepted the resignation of Securities Commission member Elizabeth Hickey.

Ms Hickey's resignation takes effect from 30 April 2010. 

"It is with regret that I have accepted Ms Hickey's decision to leave the Commission for personal reasons after nearly two years in the job," Mr Power said.

"I would like to take this opportunity to thank her for her work as a member of the Commission and wish her well for the future."
